title: New Reports filter types behave correctly (Location, Transaction Type, etc.)
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the reports that use them (for example A/R Aging Detail, Notes) report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. Each new filter type (Location, Transaction Type, Invoice Status, Type, User, Mention) opens a list of choices and filters the report by the choice.

2. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (the exact choices, single- vs multi-select, and how each new filter type filters the report).
